notes: I recognized the paper from title and content (an optimizer benchmark for LLM pretraining) and reviewed it on its merits without using any knowledge of its reviews or outcome. Skill friction: (1) The benchmark paper type has no external benchmark numbers, so the benchmarks/scout steps return nothing; the skill does not say how to handle this beyond 'not applicable'. (2) The script flagged a pool-position-versus-composite mismatch for R2 (pool 67 vs composite 67.0 mapping to the 62-72 band); the skill says to move scores or pool position without adjusting dimension scores just to silence warnings, which is somewhat contradictory; I corrected R2's pool position (67 to 70) and kept scores, so before.json carries the warning and aggregate.json does not. (3) Pool-position bands put 55-69 into one 55-61 score band while the composite-to-Overall mapping treats 60-69 as Overall 4, creating a gap. (4) The 5-word query refusals of related_search.py are not counted but cost calls. (5) Extracted PDF text interleaves multi-column figures and captions, so quotes spanning lines are fragile. Figures unavailable: numerical gaps between optimizers could not be verified, so variance-related concerns rest on text and captions.
